entries.3c8517d5fc501158: This business centers on operating the travel comparison site "Travelko". "Travelko" is a metasearch site that lets users search and compare, online and in one place, travel products such as package tours, hotels and air tickets sold by more than 1,500 booking sites (as of the end of March 2026), including major domestic travel agencies, domestic and overseas OTAs, and domestic and overseas hotels and airlines. Users can use the service free of charge to find travel products that match their preferred conditions and make reservations or inquiries. The consolidated subsidiary Hotel Skip Co., Ltd. operates the hotel booking site "Hotelia" and the air ticket booking site "Travelia", and also sells travel products to corporate customers. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,453 million.

entries.58f544a5a718aef7: It sets out in its corporate philosophy not fearing new challenges and continuing to contribute to society's richness, joy, and future with untiring innovativeness, and develops its business centered on operating Travelko under a mission of responding quickly to changing market needs and achieving No.1 customer satisfaction with the fastest speed and the highest quality. As priority issues, it cites responding to technological innovation including generative AI, strengthening the service functions of Travelko and developing new menus, raising brand recognition, strengthening overseas businesses including inbound response through multilingual development, and developing new services and new businesses. In new businesses, it states that it will promote, among other things, introducing new menus such as cruises to Travelko and implementing an AI search function, providing AI-based services for companies, expanding introduction of online reservation systems and business travel systems for travel agencies, and starting an EC marketplace business for traditional crafts at KOGEI JAPAN.
